save_state_reader.cpu_types_dependency: mstan/arm-recomp-core@61cdc51a85efe621841458d9e6c35c5357fcb2ee/profiles/armv4t_gba/runtime_arm_types.h (bound by exact parent gitlink; blob verified)
save_state_reader.classification: Versioned guest/device snapshot plus advisory counters and optional explicitly versioned native mod-provider state, not a dump of build-private globals/host function pointers.

safe_claims.fact: GBAS magic, version1/2, ROM SHA1, framed section bounds, duplicate/trailing/missing section checks and optionalMODS catalog/schema/provider preflight precede mutation.
CPU payload is ArmCpuState guest register/banked uint32 storage plus guest return-PC stack. No host function pointer serialized.

Guest memory/devices/audio sample rings/framebuffer bookkeeping; CPU and audio use raw pointer-freePOD fields, other fields use fixed scalar framing. Upstream snapshot version owns layout compatibility; no build fingerprint is present.
MODS validates exact registered provider count/id/schema and bounded payload/preflight before guest mutation. No native-code cache DLL is saved in .stateN.

known_limits.fact: No per-section SnapshotReader.ok()/remaining validation around CPU/BUS/IO/AUDIO/SAVE/PPU deserialization. A container with valid outer framing but too-short/changed payload can mutate then returntrue. Do not claim malformed-state rejection beforemutation.
Whole statefile size and section-supplied callstack/audio/save vector lengths lack before-allocation caps; bounded cursor alone does not establish bounded parser resources.

battery_save_distinction.fact: Battery .sav stores ordinary SRAM/EEPROM/Flash bytes with runtime size/type handling, atomic temp/fallback backup writes and size-change preservation. It is not the full .stateN snapshot.

desktop_activation.fact: Desktop defaults do not enable automatic suspend-state restoration; .stateN loads require user action/explicit --load-state. Android/mobile mode remains separately upstream-owned.

save_state_reader.fit_disposition: No source evidence here justifies a Sonic-style native-host-snapshot releasepin or blanket managed-route deferral. Existing ready archive fit remains available with current declared data preserved, no crossversion savestate guarantee, old runtime/copy retained, and explicit upstream malformed-state limitation. This does not certify any uninspected future native release or repair the upstream parser.
